rules.description: Same physical pin assigned to multiple functions
MUX value not in device pinmux table
Power/ground/fixed pin cannot generate GPIO code
ePWM enabled without Trip Zone OST — no hardware protection
Complementary ePWM with zero dead band — shoot-through risk
TBPRD value exceeds 0xFFFF for requested frequency/divider
SOC CHSEL does not match physical ADCIN pin
Same SOC number used by more than one channel
AIO pin used as digital GPIO while also mapped to ADC
ADC acquisition window < 7 cycles — may cause inaccurate results
PLL DIV/DIVSEL combination exceeds 60 MHz SYSCLK limit
Same PIE interrupt vector assigned to multiple sources
TBCLKSYNC cleared but never re-enabled — all ePWM counters frozen
Configuration parameter still UNRESOLVED — cannot export
PWM output released before Trip Zone, AQ, and Dead Band configured
